description: This file defines data structures, enums, and classes related to configuration and file source tracking within the 'cuttlefish' namespace, including the CvdFile struct and FetcherConfig class, along with associated methods and external dependencies.

classes.name: CvdFile
classes.description: Represents a file with its source, build ID, target, and path.
